sources.title: CCSDS Blue Books: Recommended Standards
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: CCSDS Reed–Solomon：符元錯誤預算
related.titleEn: CCSDS Reed–Solomon: a symbol-error correction budget
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付物能重現 20000 bytes for VC-A per cycle 與 16000 bytes for VC-A per cycle，保留失敗情境且每個通過判定有明確門檻；需分開列出模型未涵蓋的實際系統驗證。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: The artifacts must reproduce 20000 bytes for VC-A per cycle and 16000 bytes for VC-A per cycle, preserve failing scenarios and attach a threshold to each pass decision; list actual-system validation outside this model separately.
related.difference: 能推導並解釋16 unknown symbol errors guaranteed correctable與8 unknown symbol errors guaranteed correctable，建立rs_error_positions.csv、符元分組圖、距離界限證明，並完成以下驗收：9個不同符元錯誤時只有第一碼有保證；超界不代表必然失敗，也不得宣稱必然正確。
related.differenceEn: Derive and explain 16 unknown symbol errors guaranteed correctable and 8 unknown symbol errors guaranteed correctable; create rs_error_positions.csv, symbol grouping and a minimum-distance bound proof; apply this acceptance decision: With9 erroneous symbols only the first code is guaranteed; beyond the bound neither inevitable failure nor correctness may be claimed.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 從原理 固定循環排程把框機會分配給虛擬通道；總容量不變時，提高一通道配額必降低另一通道保留量。 展開基準式 20*1000；逐步記錄中間量與單位，先手算再用計算器或Python重算。接著用不同表示法交叉檢查：產生32列槽表，統計A/B計數20/12或16/16；兩通道交付合計永遠不超32000 byte。 將兩條推導一起存入 aos_slots.csv、各VC累積佇列、18/14替代配置與隔離證據。

從原理 對最小距離n-k+1的RS碼，無擦除時保證更正floor((n-k)/2)個符元錯誤；位元錯誤數不能直接當符元數。 展開基準式 floor((255-223)/2)；逐步記錄中間量與單位，先手算再用計算器或Python重算。接著用不同表示法交叉檢查：由距離33與17核對2t<d；把9個錯誤bit分布於2個byte或9個不同byte，得到2與9錯誤符元。 將兩條推導一起存入 rs_error_positions.csv、符元分組圖、距離界限證明。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Starting from A cyclic schedule allocates frame opportunities to virtual channels; at fixed total capacity an increased quota for one reduces the reserved capacity of another., expand baseline expression 20*1000; record intermediate values and units, calculate manually, then repeat with a calculator or Python. Use this independent representation: Generate32 schedule rows and count A/B as20/12 or16/16; combined delivery never exceeds32000 bytes. Save both derivations with aos_slots.csv, per-VC queue totals and evidence for an isolated18/14 alternative.

Starting from For an RS code of minimum distance n-k+1, the guaranteed unknown-symbol correction radius is floor((n-k)/2); bit errors cannot be counted directly as symbol errors., expand baseline expression floor((255-223)/2); record intermediate values and units, calculate manually, then repeat with a calculator or Python. Use this independent representation: Check2t<d using distances33 and17; distribute9 erroneous bits across2 bytes or9 separate bytes, yielding2 or9 erroneous symbols. Save both derivations with rs_error_positions.csv, symbol grouping and a minimum-distance bound proof.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: 色散管理：雷射線寬與脈衝展寬
related.titleEn: Dispersion management: laser linewidth and pulse broadening
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付物能重現 20000 bytes for VC-A per cycle 與 16000 bytes for VC-A per cycle，保留失敗情境且每個通過判定有明確門檻；需分開列出模型未涵蓋的實際系統驗證。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: The artifacts must reproduce 20000 bytes for VC-A per cycle and 16000 bytes for VC-A per cycle, preserve failing scenarios and attach a threshold to each pass decision; list actual-system validation outside this model separately.
related.difference: 完成兩組條件的可重算判定，指出哪些觀察能區分原因。 教學延遲展寬上限200 ps；0.10 nm組可進下一測試，0.20 nm需縮頻或補償後再驗。
related.differenceEn: Produce reproducible decisions for both configurations and identify observations that discriminate causes. Teaching spread limit200 ps: the0.10 nm case proceeds; the0.20 nm case requires narrower spectrum or compensation and re-test.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 從原理 固定循環排程把框機會分配給虛擬通道；總容量不變時，提高一通道配額必降低另一通道保留量。 展開基準式 20*1000；逐步記錄中間量與單位，先手算再用計算器或Python重算。接著用不同表示法交叉檢查：產生32列槽表，統計A/B計數20/12或16/16；兩通道交付合計永遠不超32000 byte。 將兩條推導一起存入 aos_slots.csv、各VC累積佇列、18/14替代配置與隔離證據。
合成D=17 ps/(nm km)、L=80 km，線寬0.10改0.20 nm，其他條件固定。 名義式 17*80*0.1 = 136 ps；變更式 17*80*0.2 = 272 ps。逐項標示量綱，先代入未四捨五入數值再作比較。 手算名義式並保存所有中間項，實作下列獨立驗證而非只抄最終數字： 分別計算兩端波長的群延遲差，核對D的正負與絕對展寬；將結果除位元時間但不據此宣稱BER。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Starting from A cyclic schedule allocates frame opportunities to virtual channels; at fixed total capacity an increased quota for one reduces the reserved capacity of another., expand baseline expression 20*1000; record intermediate values and units, calculate manually, then repeat with a calculator or Python. Use this independent representation: Generate32 schedule rows and count A/B as20/12 or16/16; combined delivery never exceeds32000 bytes. Save both derivations with aos_slots.csv, per-VC queue totals and evidence for an isolated18/14 alternative.

Synthetic D=17 ps/(nm km), L=80 km, linewidth changed from0.10 to0.20 nm with other conditions fixed. Nominal 17*80*0.1 = 136 ps; changed 17*80*0.2 = 272 ps. Label dimensions, substitute unrounded values and only then compare. Calculate the nominal expression with intermediate terms and implement this independent validation rather than copying the final number: Calculate delays at both spectral edges, check the sign of D and absolute spread; normalize by bit time without claiming a BER.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
